decision: Explicit ambiguous-behavior wording identifies five-behavior hostility outcome, distinct from Ronald/Donald person trait ratings; unlabeled CI/heterogeneity numbers in coding context do not override named outcome. Primary22-lab sample N5610 explicitly printed and Fig2 counts2813+2797; all26-lab7373 and ancillary analyses not substituted, repeated five ratings do not multiply participant N. Hold requested Cohen d: behavior raw MD=-.08 is not d, and source approximate d.06 in Discussion is for the positive person-rating effect, not behavior outcome. No documented unique standardized conversion adopted. Authors explicitly describe behavior result opposite predicted direction and conclude current methods do not yield practically routinely detectable assimilation; failed applies to identified behavior outcome, not inferred solely from nonsignificance. Numeric source CI/rounding retained; no correction from d.08 to raw MD-.08.
